populations.all_scope_pairs: 17 candidates per instance (all but neutral1 and goal): 136 pairs x 8 = 1088

a_prediction_error.definition: err_f(a) = mean |z_pred_f(a) - z_real(a)| over all entries (float64); summary over the candidates of the 8 instances in each (class, commanded mm) group

b_dispersion.definition: token_std = mean over the 1664 channels of the population std over the 600 tokens (2x15x20); mean_abs = mean |z| over all entries; token_l1 = mean over tokens of sum_c |z| (= 1664 * mean_abs)

c_moving_reference.definition: dC(a) = C_f(a) - C_f(onray-plus-0.001), own goal, commands >= 1 cm, same field f for both terms

d_realized_corrected.definition: C_real_corr(a) = C(z_real_i(a), g_i) - mean_j F_real(a, j)

e_physical_approach.definition: dDf(a, j) = |ee_i(a) - ee_j(goal)| - |ee_i(neutral0) - ee_j(goal)| (mm); pairs with commands >= 1 cm

pred_cmd.enumeration: baseline b_i(a) = F(a, j) with j = (i + k) mod 8, k = 1..7

pred_exec.enumeration: baseline b_i(a) = F(a, j) with j = (i + k) mod 8, k = 1..7
